scenarios.label: Nifty 50 falls 10%
scenarios.basis: Each holding moves by its beta to the benchmark; 3 holdings without 26 weeks of prices are taken at 1.0.

scenarios.label: Every holding back at its 52-week low
scenarios.basis: Each holding's lowest weekly close of the last year; 2 holdings without a range are left unchanged.

scenarios.label: The worst 4 weeks of the last year again
scenarios.basis: Today's weights through the weeks of 2025-12-29 to 2026-01-23.
